description: Retrieve the precomputed Coordination Topology — the structural lineage layer over the parent→child Coordination Connection graph (a DAG). Omit `node_id` for whole-graph network statistics (taxonomy-class counts, roots, multi-parent nodes, dominant roots by coordination reach, weakly-connected components). Pass `node_id` (e.g. "E34") for one node's structural metrics: generational depth (min/max/all-paths), coordination reach, directed betweenness, path diversity, fan-in/out, taxonomy class, component id. For the actual paths between nodes or up/down a lineage use `traverse_coordination`; for one event's value-chain stack use `get_event_stack`. Optional `class` / `cc_type` / `min_reach` filters return matching nodes. The full tier adds the held analyst layer (chain participation, curated orphan/sibling and named-feature sets).

cc_type.description: Filter to nodes incident to a backbone (parent→child) edge of this type (1–7)

class.description: Filter nodes by taxonomy class: root | internal | leaf | sibling_only | orphan

min_reach.description: Filter to nodes with coordination_reach >= this value

node_id.description: Node id e.g. "E34"; omit for the whole-graph summary

name: get_topology
title: Get Coordination Topology
